notes.title: Our Dear Kingdom: Dragon Update
notes.content:
This is the first big update since the game is released. Thank you for buying, playing or just checking out the game. It really means a lot to me.

Having people play the game also means having more feedback. After listening to it I made some changes.

Let's dig into the update:

The first major change is the addition of the black dragon. It is like the regoular dragon, but it is a lot stronger. You can see some screenshots below. This is how it appears ingame.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032665/080f23740415e36f1ffdfc8d6298856df1168d65.png

Another dragon change is that they  now target buildings and not the whole map. This will make the game a bit harder.

A very requested feature and complaint was that there was no option to invert the mouse control directions. It is now present in the ingame options menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032665/ff8f9ef6a619de7bbd9f6582a2662549f9ddb165.png


Again, thank you for playing Our Dear Kingdom and checking out this update!

notes.title: Final update before release, lighing improvement!
notes.content:
The release of the game is very close and the game is in a good playable state.

Of course, the features that could be added are a lot, but the line needs to be placed somewhere.

In this final update before release, the lighting got a major improvement, as it can be seen in the pictures. The shadows in particular are a lot better. They will have a small impact on performance, but it should be ok.

Here the before and after side by side:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032665/11adbd5103fc674d00f0ef4712d020d2dd713cc6.png


Before:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032665/7c36e80f00fb685672b04a5e6e7280ae1a0d6343.png


After:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032665/7393bc791706bb92d0ec9f67038cf343d1716a90.png


As you can see the previous one had a more washed out look. But with this new look the colors look much better

The images in the store page are not updated yet with the new lights, but hopefully you will like the game anyway!

I hope you're going to enjoy the game and that the release will be ok!
